stem:
Statements **A** to **E** relate to biological molecules.

For each statement, identify the most appropriate term that matches the description.

parts.label: A
parts.text: The molecule formed from a condensation reaction between fructose and glucose.

parts.label: B
parts.text: The name of the bond broken when two amino acids are separated by hydrolysis.

parts.label: C
parts.text: The unbranched polymer consisting only of $\beta$-glucose molecules.

parts.label: D
parts.text: The reagent used to test for the presence of proteins.

parts.label: E
parts.text: The molecule produced, in addition to fatty acids, when a triglyceride is hydrolysed.
